subject: NetworkPkg: Ip4Dxe/Ip6Dxe: Set SB notify to NULL after event close
reasons: Clear before/after pattern: after gBS->CloseEvent(X), set X = NULL to prevent double-close
Applied consistently in two parallel locations (Ip4Config2Impl.c and Ip6ConfigImpl.c) following the same guard pattern (if (X != NULL) { CloseEvent(X); X = NULL; })
This is a well-known edk2 idiom fix (NULL-after-close) that likely has analogous instances elsewhere in NetworkPkg or other packages
Structurally mechanical: Coccinelle can match CloseEvent inside a non-NULL guard and insert the NULL assignment
